title: Predicate-specific node executions with stored artifacts (P-RET/P-CAL/P-CHAN, P-OBS, P-ERASE, P-PRES)
objective: Extend rso/witness/ares_client.py so every node the preregistration names (s4, s5) is executed by its own pattern and returns the BYTES of every artifact the interface (PREREGISTRATION s7) names, with role, dtype and shape in the receipt: episode runs over seeds (P-RET, P-CAL, P-CHAN, RECUR); record vs no-record (P-OBS); the probe pairs (P-ERASE); warm vs fresh (P-PRES).
problem: The evaluator (C-010-T012, Argus) recomputes everything from these bytes; the driver (C-010-T011, Eupalamus) stores them. Plumbing tests on random / hand-wired organisms only; no count, accuracy or outcome on any registered arm.
non_goals: No subject GA run and no witness episode before FREEZE_W1 and the challenge (PREREGISTRATION s10)
No accuracy / retention / reward statistic on any registered arm before the witness launches
No edit of ares/ sources; no change to rso/binding or the slice evidence plane
evidence_required: each node pattern returns its artifact bytes with layout

acceptance.command: python -B -m unittest discover -s rso/witness/tests -t . && python -B -m unittest discover -s rso/binding/tests -t .
